title: Conditionals: guided lesson
description: Short summary with a link to the official Python tutorial (Python Software Foundation).
content: if runs a block when its condition is True; elif is tried only if earlier conditions were False; else is the fallback. 0, '' and empty collections count as False.

title: Loops and range(): guided lesson
description: Short summary with a link to the official Python tutorial (Python Software Foundation).
content: for loops visit each item of a sequence. range(n) gives 0 to n-1 and range(a, b) gives a to b-1. break exits a loop. A while loop needs its condition to become False.

title: Strings and lists: guided lesson
description: Short summary with a link to the official Python tutorial (Python Software Foundation).
content: Strings and lists are indexed from 0 and slices s[a:b] stop before b. Lists have append(); strings have split() and join().

title: Strings and lists: worked example
description: Short code example written by the team. Works offline.
content:
s = 'python'
print(s[1])         # y
nums = [1, 2, 3, 4]
print(nums[1:3])    # [2, 3]
print('a-b-c'.split('-'))   # ['a', 'b', 'c']

title: Functions and return values: guided lesson
description: Short summary with a link to the official Python tutorial (Python Software Foundation).
content: def creates a function. Parameters can have defaults. return sends a value back and ends the function; without return the result is None.

title: Functions and return values: worked example
description: Short code example written by the team. Works offline.
content:
def add(a, b=2):
    return a + b
print(add(3))       # 5
print(add(3, 4))    # 7

title: Dictionaries and sets: guided lesson
description: Short summary with a link to the official Python tutorial (Python Software Foundation).
content: A dict maps unique keys to values: d['a'] reads a value and d.get('b') returns None if the key is missing. A set keeps only unique items.

title: Debugging and problem solving: guided lesson
description: Short summary with a link to the official Python tutorial (Python Software Foundation).
content: Read the last line of the error first. NameError: name not defined. TypeError: wrong type for an operation. ValueError: right type, bad value. Use print() to trace values step by step.

title: Debugging and problem solving: worked example
description: Short code example written by the team. Works offline.
content:

# '5' + 2 raises TypeError
x = 10
